formula: Namely is used after a general statement to identify the exact person, thing, reason, question or list being discussed

formulas.formula: Namely is used after a general statement to identify the exact person, thing, reason, question or list being discussed

example: Three departments were affected—namely, sales, finance and operations.
exampleZh: 三個部門受到影響，即銷售部、財務部和營運部。

examples.en: Three departments were affected—namely, sales, finance and operations.
examples.zh: 三個部門受到影響，即銷售部、財務部和營運部。
examples.highlight: Three departments were affected—namely, sales, finance and operations.

rules.zh: 目標表達【Namely】表示「確切來說是……」公司只有一個海外辦事處，即位於新加坡的辦事處。 這句準確指出是哪一個海外辦事處。
rules.en: Namely Namely introduces the exact identity or complete information. The company has one overseas office—namely, the one in Singapore. The sentence identifies the exact overseas office.

rules.zh: 與 for example 不同部分部門受到影響，例如銷售部和財務部。 可能還有其他部門受到影響。三個部門受到影響，即銷售部、財務部和營運部。 受到影響的就是這三個部門。
rules.en: Namely For example introduces one or more possible examples. Other examples may also exist. Namely identifies exactly what the speaker means. The stated list is normally complete. For example Some departments, for example sales and finance, were affected. Other departments may also have been affected. Namely Three departments were affected—namely, sales, finance and operations. These are the three departments affected.

rules.zh: 目標表達【Namely】本身才是核心詞語核心詞語是：【namely】 破折號、冒號、逗號和句中位置並非固定組成部分，而是按照句子結構改變。
rules.en: Namely The core word is: namely The dash, colon, commas and sentence position are not fixed parts of the expression. They change according to the sentence structure. namely

rules.zh: 後面可以接不同形式名詞或名詞詞組只有一個人可以批准這項申請，也就是校長。 第 B 項【A list】：清單；旗幟有三種顏色，即紅、白和藍。 報告提出一項主要主張，即新系統能節省時間。 文章探討一個問題，即學校是否應限制家課。 政策有兩個目標，即減少浪費和降低成本。 培訓集中培養三項技能，即細心聆聽、提出清晰問題和準確記錄筆記。
rules.en: Namely A noun or noun phrase Only one person can approve the request—namely, the head teacher. The flag contains three colours, namely red, white and blue. That + clause The report makes one main claim, namely that the new system saves time. Whether + clause The article discusses one question—namely, whether schools should limit homework. To + verb The policy has two aims: namely, to reduce waste and to lower costs. V-ing phrases The training focuses on three skills, namely listening carefully, asking clear questions and taking accurate notes.

rules.zh: 一般資料必須先出現兩名學生獲選，分別是亞倫和克洛伊。 只有當上一句已經提出一般資料時，才適合在新一句開頭使用 Namely。
rules.en: Namely normally follows a general description. Two students were selected—namely, Aaron and Chloe. The phrase two students gives the general information. The names give the exact information. Namely, Aaron and Chloe were selected. This is unclear unless a previous sentence has already mentioned the two students.

rules.zh: 數目必須與清單吻合數目必須與其後列出的內容一致。
rules.en: Three colours were used—namely, red, white and blue. Two colours were used—namely, red, white and blue. The number and the list must agree.

rules.zh: 後面通常不使用 etc. 詞語【Namely】表示其後會列出確切或完整資料，因此一般不應在其後加入 etc.。
rules.en: Namely The shop sells three kinds of fruit—namely, apples, pears, grapes, etc. The word namely suggests that the exact or complete information will follow. Adding etc. makes the list incomplete.

rules.zh: 不要同時使用 namely 和 such as； 公司只有一個海外辦事處，即位於新加坡的辦事處。 在這個句式中，namely 後面通常加上逗號。只有一個人可以批准這項申請，也就是校長。
rules.en: Three departments were affected—namely, such as sales and finance. or: Several departments were affected, such as sales and finance. Namely and such as perform different jobs and should not be joined together in this way. After a dash General statement — namely, exact detail or list The company has one overseas office—namely, the one in Singapore. A comma is normally placed after namely in this pattern. After a colon General statement: namely, exact detail or list Only one person can approve the request: namely, the head teacher.

rules.zh: 工作坊涵蓋兩個主題，即面試技巧和履歷表寫作。 報告提出一項主張，即該系統能節省時間。 在這個緊密句式中，namely 後面通常不會立即再加逗號。我們最年輕的員工，即佐伊，將帶領導賞團。 獎品，即一部新平板電腦，將於星期五頒發。 確切身分或內容插入句子中間。計劃因一個簡單原因而失敗。也就是預算太少。 上一句必須已經提出一般概念。
rules.en: After a comma General statement, namely exact detail or list The workshop covers two topics, namely interview skills and CV writing. The report makes one claim, namely that the system saves time. In this compact pattern, a second comma is not normally placed immediately after namely. Inside a sentence General noun, namely exact identity, rest of sentence Our youngest employee, namely Zoe, will lead the tour. The prize, namely a new tablet, will be presented on Friday. The exact identity is inserted in the middle of the sentence. At the beginning of a follow-up sentence General statement. Namely, complete explanation. The plan failed for one simple reason. Namely, the budget was too small. The previous sentence must already contain the general idea.

rules.zh: 報告提出一項主要主張，即新系統能節省時間。 旅程只因一個原因而取消，也就是天氣已變得危險。 文章探討一個問題，即學校是否應限制家課。 這個句式準確指出正在考慮的問題。政策有兩個目標，即減少浪費和降低成本。 培訓涵蓋三項技能，即聆聽、提問和記錄筆記。
rules.en: Namely that + clause A fact / reason / claim / conclusion + namely that + clause The report makes one main claim, namely that the new system saves time. The trip was cancelled for one reason, namely that the weather had become dangerous. Namely whether + clause A question / issue + namely whether + clause The article discusses one question—namely, whether schools should limit homework. This pattern identifies the exact question being considered. Namely to + verb An aim / purpose / task + namely, to + base verb Namely + V-ing A skill / activity / responsibility + namely + V-ing The training covers three skills, namely listening, questioning and note-taking.

benefits.zh: 準確指出你所談論的內容公司只有一個海外辦事處，即位於新加坡的辦事處。 讀者不需要猜測句子所指的是哪一個辦事處。
benefits.en: Namely helps the reader understand exactly which person, thing or idea you mean. The company has one overseas office—namely, the one in Singapore. The reader does not need to guess which office is being discussed.

benefits.zh: 把一般資料和具體資料連接起來你可以先提出一個一般類別，然後列出確切名稱或資料。三項服務受到影響，即交通、銀行和網上預訂服務。
benefits.en: You can first introduce a general group and then provide the exact names or details. Three services were affected—namely, transport, banking and online booking. The phrase three services introduces the category. The words after namely identify the services.

benefits.zh: 令清單更容易理解直接在句中加入一串項目可能顯得突然。使用 namely 可以先提醒讀者：接下來會列出確切內容。
benefits.en: A long list may appear suddenly if it is placed directly in a sentence. Using namely tells the reader that the exact list is about to follow.

benefits.zh: 避免重複寫 these are 或 they are 使用 namely 可以把兩句合併，避免重複使用 they are 或 these are。
benefits.en: Before: Three rooms will be closed. They are the library, the computer room and the hall. After: Three rooms will be closed—namely, the library, the computer room and the hall.

benefits.zh: 適合報告、簡報和解釋性寫作它適合用於：報告；簡報；會議紀錄；說明文章；商業電郵；學術寫作。它能幫助你把一般結論和具體證據清楚連接起來。
benefits.en: Namely is useful when you need to present exact names, reasons, conditions or findings clearly.

benefits.zh: 提供不同的句子組織方法它可以出現在破折號、冒號或逗號之後，也可以放在句子中間或下一句開頭。這能增加句式變化，避免所有句子都以相同方法列出資料。
benefits.en: Namely can appear after a dash, colon or comma, inside a sentence or at the beginning of a follow-up sentence.
